items.mainDefect: The Salesforce connection uses the stale stored access token instead of the newly refreshed token.

secondary.defect: Salesforce refreshes tokens and writes credentials on every service instantiation without checking expiry.

items.mainDefect: The webhook compares its authentication secret with ordinary string equality, exposing a timing side channel.

secondary.defect: The authentication check can accept requests when both the secret header and configured secret are missing.

items.mainDefect: Colliding computed schema keys prevent the minimum token schema from validating expiry and preserving the intended token fields.

secondary.defect: The parser fabricates a refresh_token placeholder that consumers persist over the real refresh token.

items.mainDefect: Colliding computed schema keys cause the minimum token schema to strip expiry and other credential fields.

secondary.defect: The parser injects a literal refresh_token placeholder that overwrites the stored refresh token.

items.mainDefect: Colliding computed schema keys cause the minimum token schema to discard fields other than access_token.

secondary.defect: The parser fabricates a refresh_token placeholder that consumers persist over existing refresh tokens.

items.mainDefect: Salesforce performs a blocking token refresh on every service instantiation and fails construction when that refresh fails.

secondary.defect: Checking statusText against "OK" can reject successful token responses instead of using response.ok.
The Salesforce token schema requires scope even though refresh responses may omit it.

items.mainDefect: Colliding computed schema keys disable the intended expiry validation and strip other credential fields.

secondary.defect: The parser substitutes a literal refresh_token placeholder for missing refresh tokens, overwriting valid stored tokens.

items.mainDefect: The webhook lacks an HTTP method check, allowing GET or HEAD requests to reach body parsing and produce unhandled errors.

secondary.defect: Decryption and JSON parsing failures are unhandled and produce server errors for malformed ciphertext or an incorrect encryption key.
The webhook persists decrypted credential values without validating that they are objects.
The non-atomic credential lookup and creation can create duplicate credentials during concurrent webhook calls.

items.mainDefect: Colliding computed schema keys cause the minimum token schema to strip expiry and other token fields.

secondary.defect: The parser injects a refresh_token placeholder when parsing leaves that field absent.

items.mainDefect: The parser inserts a literal refresh_token placeholder for missing tokens, allowing consumers to overwrite valid stored refresh tokens.

secondary.defect: The malformed minimum token schema strips refresh_token from sharing-mode responses.
